arrangement.notes: Arrangement emphasizes an emotional phonk vibe with club energy, using varied sample chopping techniques to build texture and dynamics.

event_markers.label: hook_start
event_markers.reason: High energy vocal chops introduce the hook section

event_markers.label: bridge_reverse_effect
event_markers.reason: Reverse chops emphasize mood shift at bridge

event_markers.label: final_hook_stutter
event_markers.reason: Stutter chops add intensity for final hook climax

layers.name: micro chops
layers.description: Samples chopped into very small fragments for rhythmic texture

layers.name: phrase chops
layers.description: Longer phrase segments sliced to create new rhythmic patterns

layers.name: reverse chops
layers.description: Samples played backward for atmospheric effects

layers.name: vocal chops
layers.description: Vocal samples sliced and triggered as rhythmic or melodic elements

layers.name: stutter chops
layers.description: Rapid retriggering of small sample parts for glitchy stutter effect

sound_intent.description: Emotional phonk arrangement with mainstream appeal, club-energy focused, richly textured through various sample chopping techniques.

designer_intent.goal: Create an arrangement that balances emotional depth with high-energy dancefloor appeal by leveraging modern phonk sample chopping styles.

presetor_intent.goal: Use preset chains optimized for clear articulation of chopped samples, emphasize punch and clarity in vocal chops, and maintain wet/dry balance for effects.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythmic patterns integrating micro chops and stutter chops to maintain a dynamic club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Develop grooving bass lines that complement the chopped sample textures and support emotional mood.

harmony_generator.brief: Construct chord voicings and phrase chops that add harmonic interest without cluttering the mix.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic content primarily through vocal chop manipulation and phrase chops that enhance the arrangement’s emotion.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow ensuring energy follows the target curve and sample chops are distributed for texture and impact.

presetor.brief: Select and apply presets tailored for each chopping technique to shape tone and clarity in their respective channels.

songgps.brief: Monitor and adjust section structuring and energy markers to maintain a cohesive and engaging arrangement.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare channel audio for mix processing with focus on preserving chopped sample detail and vocal clarity.
